verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or first-party claim about compile-time type checking inside templates (e.g., vue-tsc or template type inference); the only TypeScript-related evidence is community complaints that TS support is 'mediocre' and 'a second class citizen' with manual typing required (vue-comm-4, vue-comm-15, vue-comm-17), which does not establish the capability exists.
